paras: Neusticurus tatei, also known commonly as Tate's neusticurus, is a species of lizard in the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, tatei, is in honor of American mammalogist George Henry Hamilton Tate.
N. tatei is found in the state of Bolívar, Venezuela.
The preferred natural habitat of N. tatei is forest, at altitudes of 400–1,400 m (1,300–4,600 ft).
